g.text: Stress–strain shapes reveal ductility, brittle damage, time dependence, and directional response
Qualitative normalized sketches with separate arbitrary reference scales; curve magnitudes cannot compare material strengths. Concrete shown in compression, steel in
tension; asphalt is viscoelastic and temperature/rate dependent, wood anisotropic. Shapes depend on material grade, confinement, direction and test conditions; these
